title: My Kind of Friend
style: British alt-rock with a female lead vocal, clear midrange phrasing and a chorus-lifted bridge; driving 132 BPM road-trip pulse, melodic guitar hooks over a driving bassline, punchy live drums with gated snare, distant reverbed guitar and a dance instrumental break; sidechain pumping, tape saturation, plate reverb and wide stereo guitars.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The heartland of western Europe you called it
where the Frankish Empire crafted.
You talked about history with such passion
like your nerdish themes drafted.

Our schedules matched, I said why not.
A part of me said caution, beware.
A part of me told me don’t think, go ahead.
And I’m glad I came with you there.

[Pre-Chorus]
Liège, Maastricht, Aachen, Cologne, and Bonn—
not the kind of destinies I would choose on my own.

[Chorus]
And I knew right there, you were my kind of friend,
the one that speaks with passion on things I didn’t know
and listens with interest to my nerd stuff and my blend,
with whom I can share a bed expecting no more.

[Verse 2]
That kiss in Aachen told me what I knew:
that my skin was also ready for yours.
That night in Aachen proved I wasn’t wrong,
that you could fill my contours.

The kind of man who is eager to surrender
intimacy as give rather than control,
arms I could trust not to hurt me, because
you gave in your body what was in your soul.

[Pre-Chorus]
Driving with you in the heartland of the west
in a time and place I would never have guessed.

[Chorus]
And I knew right there, you were my kind of friend,
the one that speaks with passion on things I didn’t know
and listens with interest to my nerd stuff and my blend,
with whom I can share a bed expecting no more.

[Bridge]
You showed to me along all these years
you’re a good person behind those masks,
with passion and care and no need to possess,
eager to please and willing to the tasks
of doing the right thing for the people around.
I knew it in London when I brought you home
just to keep the conversation we just started—
one first chapter in my life, a new tome.

I will remember Aachen, and that pub in London,
and the offer you gave me about Barcelona.

[Final Chorus]
And I knew right there, you were my kind of friend,
with whom I can share a bed expecting no more.

And I knew right there, you were my kind of friend,
the one that speaks with passion on things I didn’t know
and listens with interest to my nerd stuff and my blend,
with whom I can share a bed expecting no more.

Because that’s the way I do expect more.
